verdict.rationale: Polar documents no-code Checkout Links: you configure a checkout in the dashboard and share its URL, and Polar handles the rest. A Checkout Session API also supports API-driven redirect flows, so developers can send customers to a Polar-hosted checkout without building payment UI. missing for 10: any evidence that the hosted page is conversion-optimized (e.g., one-click payment methods, localization, or A/B-tested layout), explicit documentation of the hosted page's appearance and customization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Configure once in the dashboard, share the URL anywhere (your website, social media, email, a button in your app), and Polar handles the rest.
Three documented checkout surfaces: no-code Checkout Links, embedded checkout
If you want to integrate more deeply the checkout process with your website or application, you can use our dedicated API.
